last_review.summary: Reviewed each acceptance criterion and ran HTML and JavaScript checks plus Node tests for seating totals, CSV, purchase persistence, QR search, and all three A2 PDF styles with 200 guests. HTML parsing and JavaScript syntax passed, and no external runtime dependencies were found. The read-only sandbox blocked Chromium startup, so offline browser behavior, 390 px layout and touch targets, rendered previews, downloads, and phone QR scanning remain unverified.
issues: Criterion 3: Recover after an unclosed CSV quote. An unterminated quoted field on line 2 caused all 20 valid rows that followed to be discarded. Report the malformed row and resume import at the next valid record while preserving support for properly quoted multiline fields.

Criterion 3: Preserve internal spaces when round-tripping CSV. Import collapses repeated spaces in names and tags and can leave a guest unseated when the exported table label contains repeated spaces. Preserve field text and match the table label that was exported.
Criterion 5: Replace the placeholder Stripe URL in assets/config.js with the real checkout link so the Unlock button opens a usable payment page.

Criterion 6: Wait for the browser fonts before painting the preview canvas. PNG export waits for the fonts, but preview rendering can paint with fallback fonts and never repaint after the intended faces load.
Repository scope: Restore TASK.md and remove workflow-file changes from the implementation diff. The plan requires the task and workflow files to remain unchanged.
